Name: 24-Hour Clock Patcher
Author: pepoluan
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#ffff00][size=3][b]100% of Donation Points (DP) for this mod goes to Doctors without Borders (Médecins sans Frontières)[/b][/size][/color][/font]

There are several 24-hour clock mods available in Nexus.

Some don't work, the others work but causes UI glitches.

This one ... [i][b]simply works.

[/b][/i]It works [u]NOT[/u] by drawing over the HUD elements (the cause behind the aforementioned UI glitches), but by directly patching the game code (using the [i][b]Harmony[/b][/i] framework) where time-formatting is performed.

(Surprise, surprise: The game actually _can_ emit 24-hour clock ... it's just that "en" localization is hardcoded to use the archaic "am/pm" notation. I took out the whole time-localization code, making the time to be emitted as 'unlocalized' 24-hour notation.)

[b]Important Note:[/b] This mod changes [u][i]mainly[/i][/u] the clock on top right; it also patches [b][font=Courier New]Game1.getTimeOfDayString()[/font][/b] function, but whether the time in texts changes or not totally depends on the text's template.


[b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Installation[/size][/font][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install latest SMAPI
[*]Download & extract this mod into the "Mods" directory

[*]. . .
[*]Profit!
[/list]

[b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Customization[/size][/font][/b]
Nothing. Nada. Zilch. Rien.

Turn it on and that's it. You cannot customize.


[b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/font][/b]
[i]Very likely[/i] will not be compatible with mods patching the [font=Courier New]StardewValley.Menus.DayTimeMoneyBox.draw[/font] method.

[i]Might[/i] not be compatible with mods patching the [font=Courier New]Game1.getTimeOfDayString()[/font] function.

If you find an incompatible mod, please tell me, so I can coordinate with the conflicting mod's maker for a solution.


[b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Source Code[/size][/font][/b]
[url=https://sourceforge.net/projects/sdvmod-24h-harmony/]Available on SourceForge.[/url] It is released under the [b]MPL-2.0[/b] license.

Please do not ask me to move it to GitHub; that will never happen.
